objective: Allow Skill/Social Capital to transition from truthful uninitialized state to evidenced initialized state without weakening anti-fabrication, privacy, routing or live-write protections.

role_dispositions.destination: State-machine validation rejects initialized Skill Capital unless it has a non-UNKNOWN primary skill plus dated ranking, baseline/status, rationale, proof target and review trigger.
The original UNKNOWN/NOT RUN uninitialized state remains explicitly valid and protected.
Initialized Social Capital may create a role-level gap map but must keep the private contact graph unimported and relationship quality UNKNOWN where unverified.

Base SHA and Git history retain the prior guard and pre-initialization owners.

capability_probes.assertion: A newly created capital system with UNKNOWN primary skill and NOT RUN ranking still passes the guard.
An initialized owner naming a skill but lacking ranking evidence structure, proof target, baseline/status or review trigger is rejected.
Learning/finance/nutrition and ordinary social-relationship routes remain unchanged.
The previous literal-uninitialized guard and owner state remain recoverable from base SHA b094df77075a6ba46a23b35c5514a8666b734be4 and Git history.

tests.expected: PASS for the initialized owners and internal valid-uninitialized/invalid-fabricated self-tests.
PASS with legacy routing and live-write protections preserved.
